GUARDIAN.title: Guardian
GUARDIAN.description: A stalwart defender who excels at blocking and counterattacking.
GUARDIAN.aromaPrinciple: [sine][gold]The wind remembers every defense. I will not yield.[/gold][/sine]
GUARDIAN.eventDeathPrevention: The wall still stands. So must I.
GUARDIAN.goldMonologue: [sine]Enough to mend my shield and armor before the next battle...[/sine]
IRONEYE.title: Ironeye
IRONEYE.description:
A keen-eyed archer who reads the battlefield.
Keeps his distance and strikes at every opening.
IRONEYE.aromaPrinciple: [sine][green]Keep your distance. Find an opening. One arrow is enough.[/green][/sine]
IRONEYE.eventDeathPrevention: The quarry lies ahead. I cannot fall here.
REVENANT.title: Revenant
REVENANT.banter.dead.endTurnPing: Do not stop. My soul remains.
REVENANT.description:
A vengeful spirit who calls the dead to her side.
Her family answers with steel, claw, and bone.
REVENANT.aromaPrinciple: [sine][purple]In life or death, we meet again.[/purple][/sine]
REVENANT.goldMonologue: [sine]Enough to see the family through the journey.[/sine]
